tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rje btsun bi pa'i srung ba'i man ngag bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rje btsun bi pa'i srung ba'i man ngag bar chad kun sel zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mthu stobs ye shes rdo rje yis/ /bdud dang mu stegs tshogs kun 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /dpal ldan bi pa la gus btud nas/ /de yi man ngag gsal bar bri bar byas/ /srod dang tho rangs kyi tshe stan bde ba la 'dug ste skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnams sngon du song nas/ oṃ swa bha was/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i khri seṅges btegs pa'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rje btsun mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bi pa sku mdog sngo nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa'i mthil gdan steng du mnan cing / g.yon pas sdig mdzub gyen du bstan pa/ sku 'gying bag dang ldan pa la me tog sna tshogs kyi dbu rgyan dang / do shal byas shing / pus 'khyud dang bcas pa'i zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs par bsams la/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug la rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang / yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs nas ༈ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim par bsams la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ rje btsun mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bi pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ sngags kyi sgra grags stong la sems gtad nas/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ gu li/ badz+ra ka pā li/ badz+ra dhi na/ bhan dhu ha ra/ badz+ra pi aṃ/ hu tsaṃ ge sa ra bhe ta na/ kha ge e/ aṃ gi mi li/ le ga par ta/ ta u la/ ti pā ṭa/ oṃ bhi ru/

wa pa ra/ na mo ba dha ni/ wa ra ṇa/ zhes tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par dam bca' ji tsam yod kyi bar bzlas pa'i mthar/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs/ /yon tan phrin las gcig tu bsdus pa'i dngos/ /bla ma rnams dang dpal ldan bi pa/ /gnyis su med la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /mgon po khyod kyi thugs dang bdag gi sems/ /dbye bar med par gcig tu 'dres gyur nas/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba khyod ci 'dra/ /bdag kyang de 'drar 'gyur bar byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes drag tu gsol ba btab la/༈ bla ma bi pa de nyid rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ rang nyid rje btsun mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bi pa/ zhes pa nas/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar gong ltar byas pa'i rjes la/ lus kyis bi pa'i stangs ka bya/ ngag gis rlung bus shing phyir mnan/ sems kyis nad gdon bgegs dang bar du gcod pa thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par bsam/ rlung mi thub pa dang kha sbyar bzung / ye shes kyi mes phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad khyab par bsam/ yang sngar bzhin rlung 'bud/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa rgyang ring du bskrad par mos/ rlung kha sbyar bzung / thun mong ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar bas bskor ba'i nang du rang bi pa yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal gyis gang la'ang nyam nga ba dang / bag tsha ba med pas khams gsum na nga las che ba med snyam du bsam mo/༈ mchan/ rdo rje gsum gyis bsrung ba ni/ g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung mthe bong gis mnan la sor mo lhag ma gsum phral te brkyangs pa dpral bar rig la/ ak+ṣe bhi ma/ kha la reg ste/ pa tshe u pa ma/ snying gar reg la/ shi la pa tha ra/ lte bar reg la/ ha u a tshe u/ liṅgar reg la/ wa pa/ zhes pas yas rim dang / yang liṅgar reg la/ bi+ā lte bar/ pa/ snying gar/ pra/ kha la/ sa dheṃ/

dpral bar/ swā hā/ zhes brjod pa mas rim gyis reg go /rnal 'byor srung ba'i phyag rgyas bsrung ba ni/ rdo rje srung ba'i phyag rgya ni/ /snying gar bcas te bshang sgor dgrol/ /'byung po nyi ma dag la bstan/ /gzhan du na ni bar chad 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don/ rkang mthil gnyis sprad/ pus mo phyir bskyed la rlung kha sbyar du byas nas/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje phyir bsdoms pa las/ mthe bong gnyis/ gung mo gnyis/ mthe'u chung gnyis rnams rtse sprad pa'i phyag rgya snying gar bcas la/ sngags rnams yid kyis bzlas shing / mthe bong sbyar ba snying gar reg la/ ak+ṣe bhi ma/ gung mo kha dang / pa tshe u pa ma/ mthe'u chung lte ba dang / shi la pa tha ra/ gung mo liṅga dang / ha u a tshe u/ mthe'u chung bshang sgo dang / wa pa/ zhes yas rim dang / yang mthe'u chung bshang sgo dang / bi+ā gung mo liṅga dang / pa/ mthe'u chung lte ba dang / pra/ mthe bong snying ga dang / sa dheṃ/ gung mo kha dang / swā hā/ zhes mas rim dang / yang gong bzhin snying ga nas bshang sgo'i bar reg la/ bi pa/ zhes yid kyis bzlas shing rlung btang / se gol gtogs par bya'o/༈ de ltar rdzogs nas/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'grub gyur nas/ /sogs kyis dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo bar bya'o/ /zab mo sbas pa'i man ngag khyad par can/ /gsal bar bris la nyes gang bla ma dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis brtse bas bzod mdzod la/ /thugs rje chen pos bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /'dir 'bad dge ba bdag gis gang thob des/ /deng nas bzung ste sku gsum ma thob bar/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug gsung gi mdzod 'dzin zhing / /lam gyi bar chad ma lus zhi bar shog /ces pa 'di'ang rmad du byung ba'i yon tan gyi tshogs la dbang 'byor ba bla ma kun dga' legs pas bkas yang yang bskul ba la brten nas/ rje btsun gong ma'i yi ge thor bu ba rnams dang / chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po che dang /

dkar shākya grags kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs rnams las man ngag rnams tshang bar bsdus shing / bla ma dam pa'i phyag len gyis brgyan nas rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun rtogs med zhabs la sogs pa bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' drin las gsung ngag rin po che'i man ngag rnams kyi mdzod 'dzin pa shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o/ /zhes rdo rje 'chang gi zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i bir srung man ngag bar chad kun sel las thun mong ba'i nyams len dang bsrung ba gnyis bcas zur du phyungs nas mchan bu'i gsal kha cung zad dang bcas te khams ston ngag dbang len pas bris pa'o// ༈ //oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug dang / /dbyer med rje btsun sa skya pa/ /yab sras rnams la gus btud nas/ /gsang ba'i zhal gdams yi ger 'bri/ /byin rlabs dang man ngag thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang / tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa sngon du song nas/ oṃ swa bha was stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus su/ ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags pa'i gdan gyi steng du pad+ma dang / zla ba dang / nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bi pa/ sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas sdig mdzub mdzad pa'i rtse mo cung zad gug pa/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rgyab kyi dpag bsam gyi shing la sku lus brten pa/ rgyal po rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs shing / sku lus grims pa/ zhal dang spyan bgrad cing ljags 'dril ba/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing / me tog sna tshogs kyis thod bcings pa/ de'i rgyab tu dpag bsam gyi shing bzang po/ mdun du tri shu la gyen du bsgrengs pa la ḍā ma ru dpyangs pa/ g.yas su bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du thod pa bdud rtsis gang bas brgyan pa/

g.yon du rig ma mtshan ldan gyis gdugs 'dzin pa/ smin mtshams kyi thad kar srung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i dbus su bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa/ bsgoms nas/ rang gi lus kyi dbus su rtsa dbu ma chos bzhi ldan/ g.yas su ro ma/ g.yon du rkyang ma ste rtsa gsum bsam pa'i spyi bor haṃ/ mgrin par oṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar aṃ/ gsang gnas rnams su hā rnams gsal bar gyur/ ces pa ༈ mchan/ pho brang lnga'i lha'i sa bon rnams bsam ste/ dkyil 'khor lnga la btud de bskrun/ /zhes pa'i don to/ /de nas rlung kha sbyar du byas pa ni/ srog rtsol 'gog pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /zhes pa'i don bstan to/ /de nas bshang sgo'i rlung gis lte ba'i me sbar/ g.yas ro ma'i nang nas zhugs/ 'khor lo rnams mas rim gyis gsal btab/ mi de spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pas/ de las byang chub kyi sems g.yon rkyang ma nas babs/ 'khor lo rnams yas rim gyis gsal btab pa'i mthar/ ro rkyang gnyis kyi rlung dang / byang chub kyi sems rnams dbu ma'i mas sna nas zhugs te/ rlung sems thig le thams cad dbu mar thim par bsgoms la/ bum pa can thub tshad du byas te/ 'bar g.yo brtan pa la brten nas/ /zhes pa'i don to/ /de ltar rlung sems dbu mar zhugs pas/ bde stong zung 'jug gi nyams skye bar 'gyur te/ bde chen chos sku'i nam mkha' mthong / /zhes pa'i don to/ /de ltar rlung sbyor mang du byas pa'i mthar srung ba rnams byas la/ de las byung ba'i dge ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo bar bya zhing / lta ba'i rgyas gdab par bya'o/ /rje btsun gsung rab nyi 'od kyis/ /gsung ngag pad tshal kha bye nas/ /bdag blo'i bung bas legs 'thungs pas/ /man ngag sbrang rtsi'i ro 'di byung / /'di yang dge slong bsam gtan pa/ /kun dga' bzang pos man ngag rnams/ /brjed pas skrag nas yi ger bkod/ /dge des 'gro kun sangs rgyas shog
/shu bhaṃ mastu sarba dzā ga taṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sga ston ngag dbang legs pa/ bi srung man ngag bar chad kun sel/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
